transitionMatrix.name: prepare process-fault routing
transitionMatrix.authority: real publish produces reason; real batch classifies and delegates recover/reset-group; durable state is owned by cycle-state, not this driver
transitionMatrix.sourceState: prepare due from durable next, status failed
transitionMatrix.eventIdentity: due run, phase, head, PR; reason type before colon, diagnostic suffix opaque
transitionMatrix.predecessor: real publish detects overwritten bytes of a previous preparation, preserving that handoff
transitionMatrix.nextState: budget granted -> reset-group -> returned durable next; budget exhausted/reset refused -> awaiting-human with resume token
transitionMatrix.effects: Only delegated recovery/reset commands; no driver filesystem writes
transitionMatrix.terminalPreconditions: No ready-for-merge transition from a failed prepare
transitionMatrix.metrics: One budget relay; no blind preparation retry before reset. Durable redRepairs/greenRetries accounting belongs to r0-3.

negativeFamilies.direct-terminal: No route in scope produces successful terminal evidence; all probes use a blocked durable next and assert no validator dispatch.
negativeFamilies.missing-predecessor: reset-group remains the predecessor authority, unchanged; refused-reset and non-tail rows prove its refusal is not bypassed.
negativeFamilies.immutable-mutation: The driver must preserve run/phase/PR/version in its reset command (route rows). It does not write contract bytes, seals, findings or scope epochs.
negativeFamilies.history-disagreement: Persisted-history validation belongs to unchanged reset-group; refused-reset row requires the driver to park on its refusal.
negativeFamilies.wrong-identity: Authority envelope validation is unchanged; route rows bind reset to the dispatched run, phase, PR and version, not the basename suffix.
negativeFamilies.replay-restart: The driver owns no persisted transition here. Real publish creates distinct attempt identities; first and numbered filenames cross every mode. Idempotency of reset-group is not changed.
negativeFamilies.stale-writer: stale-write is a separate existing process route, not the overwritten-contract reason grammar; no write authority moves into the driver.
negativeFamilies.omitted-consumer: Applicable: both driver representations and every classification consumer execute in each route witness.
negativeFamilies.human-decision: Applicable: exhausted budget and reset refusal must park with a token; durable blocked next is preserved.
negativeFamilies.multi-group: Applicable to phase delegation: r1-g1, r1-g2 and r1-g2-rev2 are exercised; reset must carry the due phase.
negativeFamilies.active-obligation: No convergence is permitted by a failed prepare result; unknown-reason controls and no-validator assertions cover that boundary.
negativeFamilies.regression-risk: No obligation/regression ledger transition changes in this group; their persisted gates remain with resolve and later review.

nextShapeAuthority.prepare: Recognized failed prepare bypasses format retry for valid, absent and malformed next.
nextShapeAuthority.reset: reset:true with valid next follows reset.next; absent/malformed next parks with token.
nextShapeAuthority.nonTail: reset-group-not-tail follows original prepare.next, ignoring returned reset.next.
